<!--
PURPOSE
  Script 05 draws every paired animal's change in mean peak force against its change in plaque
  area (FIG_animal_response_force_vs_area.png); that figure is kept as drawn there. This script
  draws it again with a 95% ellipse around each arm, and draws the animals' day-3 levels of the
  two, each arm with its ellipse, without and with the day-0 lab reference animals. The lab
  reference was pulled once, at day 0, so it has no change and cannot be in the first figure.
  Descriptive: the arm comparisons of record are the baseline-adjusted ANCOVAs of scripts 04
  and 05.

  Ellipses: 95%, from a multivariate t distribution fitted to each group's points
  (ggplot2::stat_ellipse(type = "t"), which uses MASS::cov.trob; Venables and Ripley 2002,
  Modern Applied Statistics with S, 4th ed.), as in 05_differential-expression step 14's PCA.
  Both figures are drawn on the log scale, the scale of the ANCOVAs, so that the ellipses are
  fitted there: the change figure puts the ratio day 3 / baseline on log axes labelled as %
  change (script 05 draws the same animals on linear % axes, where an ellipse can cross -100%),
  and the levels figure puts force and plaque area on log axes. Each animal is the mean peak force
  and the mean plaque area of its threads, as scripts 04 and 05 summarise animals (a check
  compares the lab reference and the day-3 controls with script 04's table).

INPUT
  03_analyses/05_decompose-adhesion/mussel_response_classification.csv   per-animal day-3 levels
                                       and changes (script 05)
  03_analyses/03_assemble-thread-summary/thread-summary.xlsx, sheet "data"   the lab reference's
                                       threads (script 03)
  03_analyses/04_analyze-thread-strength/DESC_lab_reference.csv   script 04's summary of the lab
                                       reference and the day-3 controls (the check)

OUTPUT  03_analyses/06_force-area-figures/
  FIG_force_vs_area_change_ellipses.png   script 05's figure with a 95% ellipse around each arm
  FIG_force_vs_area_day3_levels.png       day-3 mean peak force against plaque area, one point
                                          per animal, each arm with its ellipse; without (left)
                                          and with (right) the day-0 lab reference
  RUN_provenance.txt
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

### Packages, theme, palette, inputs
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(readxl); library(tidyverse); library(patchwork) })

# Script 05's theme, so that the change figure is script 05's figure with ellipses added
my_theme <- theme(line             = element_line(linewidth = 1.0),
                  rect             = element_rect(linewidth = 1.0),
                  text             = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
                  panel.background = element_blank(),
                  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
                  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                  axis.text        = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
                  panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1.0),
                  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black"),
                  strip.text       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
                  legend.key       = element_blank(),
                  legend.position  = "none")

source(file.path(here::here(), "..", "tools", "plot_style.R"))       # colours
source(file.path(here::here(), "..", "tools", "pipeline_checks.R"))  # warn_unless(), provenance_lines()
ARMS <- c("control", "OA", "OW", "DO")

out_dir <- here::here("03_analyses", "06_force-area-figures")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
resp_csv    <- here::here("03_analyses", "05_decompose-adhesion", "mussel_response_classification.csv")
thread_xlsx <- here::here("03_analyses", "03_assemble-thread-summary", "thread-summary.xlsx")
desc_csv    <- here::here("03_analyses", "04_analyze-thread-strength", "DESC_lab_reference.csv")
for (f in c(resp_csv, thread_xlsx, desc_csv)) if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Missing ", f, ": run scripts 03 to 05 first.")

resp <- read_csv(resp_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(mussel_trt = factor(mussel_trt, levels = ARMS))
stopifnot(!anyNA(resp$mussel_trt), !anyDuplicated(resp$mussel))
```

### The lab reference, summarised as scripts 04 and 05 summarise every animal
```{r}
threads <- read_excel(thread_xlsx, sheet = "data", col_names = TRUE)
ren <- c(mussel_ID = "mussel", thread_num = "thread", treatment = "thread_trt")   # as scripts 04 and 05
for (from in names(ren)) {
  to <- ren[[from]]
  if (from %in% names(threads) && !to %in% names(threads)) names(threads)[names(threads) == from] <- to
}
norm_id <- function(x) {                       # scripts 04 and 05's mussel ID normalisation
  x   <- trimws(as.character(x))
  pre <- sub("^([A-Za-z]+).*$", "\\1", x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^[A-Za-z]+0*([0-9]+).*$", "\\1", x)))
  ifelse(is.na(num) | pre == x, NA_character_, sprintf("%s%03d", pre, num))
}
lab <- threads %>%
  filter(thread_trt == "lab_control") %>%
  mutate(mussel = norm_id(mussel), adhesion_kpa = max_force / pad_area * 1000) %>%
  filter(!is.na(adhesion_kpa)) %>%
  group_by(mussel) %>%
  summarise(n_threads = n(), mean_force = mean(max_force), pad_area = mean(pad_area), .groups = "drop")

## check: the lab reference and the day-3 controls are script 04's (DESC_lab_reference.csv)
desc <- read_csv(desc_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
ref_of <- function(metric, group) desc$mean[desc$metric == metric & desc$reference_group == group]
n_of   <- function(group) desc$n[desc$metric == "mean_force" & desc$reference_group == group]
ctl <- resp %>% filter(mussel_trt == "control")
warn_unless(nrow(lab) == n_of("lab_day0") &&
              abs(mean(lab$mean_force) - ref_of("mean_force", "lab_day0")) < 1e-9 &&
              abs(mean(lab$pad_area) - ref_of("pad_area", "lab_day0")) < 1e-9,
            "The lab reference's per-animal means differ from script 04's DESC_lab_reference.csv.")
warn_unless(nrow(ctl) == n_of("control_day3") &&
              abs(mean(ctl$mean_force_post) - ref_of("mean_force", "control_day3")) < 1e-9 &&
              abs(mean(ctl$pad_area_post) - ref_of("pad_area", "control_day3")) < 1e-9,
            "The day-3 controls' per-animal means differ from script 04's DESC_lab_reference.csv.")
## check: the plotted change is script 05's % change
pr <- resp %>% filter(paired)
warn_unless(max(abs(100 * (exp(pr$mean_force_change) - 1) - pr$mean_force_pct_change),
                abs(100 * (exp(pr$pad_area_change) - 1) - pr$pad_area_pct_change)) < 1e-8,
            "The change on the axes differs from script 05's % change.")
cat(sprintf("Lab reference: %d animals, %d threads. Day-3 animals: %d (%s); paired: %d\n", nrow(lab), sum(lab$n_threads),
            nrow(resp), paste(sprintf("%s %d", ARMS, as.integer(table(resp$mussel_trt))), collapse = ", "), nrow(pr)))
```

### Figure: script 05's figure with a 95% ellipse around each arm
```{r fig.width=7.5, fig.height=6.8, warning=FALSE}
resp_p <- pr %>% mutate(x = 100 * (exp(pad_area_change) - 1), y = 100 * (exp(mean_force_change) - 1))

## axes on the log scale of the ratio day 3 / baseline (the ANCOVAs' scale), labelled as % change:
## the ellipses are fitted there, so they are ellipses and none crosses -100%
pct_log <- scales::new_transform("pct_log", transform = function(x) log1p(x / 100),
                                 inverse = function(y) 100 * expm1(y))
p_change <- ggplot(resp_p, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = mussel_trt, colour = mussel_trt), geom = "polygon", type = "t", level = 0.95,
               alpha = 0.08, linewidth = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = mussel_trt, shape = response_class), size = 3.6, stroke = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = mussel), size = 2.4, vjust = -1.1, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(transform = pct_log, breaks = c(-75, -50, -25, 0, 25, 50, 100, 200)) +
  scale_y_continuous(transform = pct_log, breaks = c(-75, -50, -25, 0, 25, 50, 100)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = TREATMENT_COLORS, name = "Arm", guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = TREATMENT_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(weaker = 25, stronger = 24, mixed = 21), name = "Response") +
  labs(x = "Plaque area, day 3 vs baseline (%, log scale)",
       y = "Mean peak force, day 3 vs baseline (%, log scale)",
       caption = paste("Every animal with baseline and day-3 threads. Axes: the ratio day 3 / baseline on a log scale",
                       "(the ANCOVAs' scale), labelled as % change; ellipses 95% (multivariate t) around each arm.",
                       "The day-0 lab reference has no baseline, so it has no change to show. Descriptive: the arm",
                       "comparisons are the baseline-adjusted ANCOVAs of scripts 04 and 05. Script 05 draws the",
                       "same animals on linear % axes (FIG_animal_response_force_vs_area.png).", sep = "\n")) +
  my_theme + theme(legend.position = "right", plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0))
p_change
## check: the ellipses are those of the log ratios themselves
e_log <- ggplot_build(ggplot(resp_p, aes(pad_area_change, mean_force_change, group = mussel_trt)) +
                        stat_ellipse(type = "t", level = 0.95))$data[[1]]
e_fig <- ggplot_build(p_change)$data[[3]]
warn_unless(nrow(e_log) == nrow(e_fig) && max(abs(e_log$x - e_fig$x), abs(e_log$y - e_fig$y)) < 1e-9,
            "The figure's ellipses are not those of the log ratios.")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "FIG_force_vs_area_change_ellipses.png"), plot = p_change,
       dpi = 600, width = 7.5, height = 6.8, units = "in")
```

### Figure: day-3 levels, without and with the day-0 lab reference
```{r fig.width=11, fig.height=6.2, warning=FALSE}
lev <- bind_rows(resp %>% transmute(mussel, group = as.character(mussel_trt), mean_force = mean_force_post, pad_area = pad_area_post),
                 lab %>% transmute(mussel, group = "LC", mean_force, pad_area)) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("LC", ARMS)))
n_grp <- table(lev$group)
GROUP_COLORS <- c(LC = THREAD_TRT_COLORS[["lab_control"]], TREATMENT_COLORS)
GROUP_SHAPES <- c(LC = 21, control = 21, OA = 22, OW = 24, DO = 23)   # filled shapes; LC and control differ by fill and ellipse line
GROUP_LABELS <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n %d)", c("Lab reference, day 0", "Control, day 3", "OA, day 3", "OW, day 3", "DO, day 3"),
                                 as.integer(n_grp[c("LC", ARMS)])), c("LC", ARMS))
scales_groups <- list(
  scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, labels = GROUP_LABELS, limits = names(GROUP_LABELS), drop = FALSE, name = NULL),
  scale_colour_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, labels = GROUP_LABELS, limits = names(GROUP_LABELS), drop = FALSE, name = NULL),
  scale_shape_manual(values = GROUP_SHAPES, labels = GROUP_LABELS, limits = names(GROUP_LABELS), drop = FALSE, name = NULL),
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(LC = "dashed", control = "solid", OA = "solid", OW = "solid", DO = "solid"),
                        limits = names(GROUP_LABELS), guide = "none"))
levels_panel <- function(d, title) {
  ggplot(d, aes(pad_area, mean_force)) +
    ## show.legend = TRUE: both panels draw a key for every group, so their legends are identical and merge
    stat_ellipse(aes(fill = group, colour = group, linetype = group), geom = "polygon", type = "t", level = 0.95,
                 alpha = 0.10, linewidth = 0.6, show.legend = TRUE) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = group, shape = group), colour = "grey15", size = 2.6, stroke = 0.4, show.legend = TRUE) +
    scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() + scales_groups +
    labs(x = expression(paste("Plaque area (", mm^2, ", log scale)")), y = "Mean peak force (N, log scale)", title = title) +
    my_theme + theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"), aspect.ratio = 1)
}
p_with    <- levels_panel(lev, "Day 3 and the day-0 lab reference")
p_without <- levels_panel(lev %>% filter(group != "LC"), "Day 3, every arm")
## the same axes in both panels, wide enough for every ellipse of the panel with the lab reference
rng <- ggplot_build(p_with)$layout$panel_params[[1]]
lims <- coord_cartesian(xlim = 10^rng$x.range, ylim = 10^rng$y.range, expand = FALSE)
p_levels <- ((p_without + lims) | (p_with + lims)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(caption = paste("One point per animal: the mean peak force and the mean plaque area of its day-3 threads (the lab reference: its day-0 threads),",
                                  "as scripts 04 and 05 summarise animals; every animal with day-3 threads, with or without baseline threads.",
                                  "Ellipses 95% (multivariate t) on the log scale. Descriptive: the arm comparisons of record are the baseline-adjusted ANCOVAs (scripts 04 and 05).",
                                  sep = "\n"),
                  theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0))) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_levels

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "FIG_force_vs_area_day3_levels.png"), plot = p_levels,
       dpi = 600, width = 11, height = 6.2, units = "in")
```

### Provenance
```{r}
ts_repo_root <- psmfc_repo_root(here::here())
ts_inputs <- c(resp_csv, thread_xlsx, desc_csv, here::here("01_code", "06_force_area_figures.Rmd"),
               file.path(ts_repo_root, "tools", c("plot_style.R", "pipeline_checks.R")))
writeLines(provenance_lines(c(paste0("generated : ", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
             paste0("animals   : day 3 ", nrow(resp), " (", paste(sprintf("%s %d", ARMS, as.integer(table(resp$mussel_trt))), collapse = ", "),
                    "), paired ", nrow(pr), "; lab reference ", nrow(lab), " (", sum(lab$n_threads), " threads)"),
             "ellipses  : 95%, multivariate t (stat_ellipse type t), on the log scale: log ratios for the change, log levels",
             paste0("R / ggplot2 : ", R.version.string, " / ", as.character(packageVersion("ggplot2")))),
             ts_inputs, ts_repo_root, packages = c("ggplot2", "patchwork")),
           file.path(out_dir, "RUN_provenance.txt"))
cat(readLines(file.path(out_dir, "RUN_provenance.txt")), sep = "\n")
if (length(.checks$failed)) stop("check failed: ", paste(.checks$failed, collapse = "; "))
```
